item.title: Crash closes Firetower Road.
item.description: An impaired driver was southbound on Firetower Road just south of SH 242. He went into the curve at Portman Road at high speed, lost control, crossed the road and slammed into a fence losing two wheels. The driver was not injured. He is believed to be impaired. The road remains closed.

item.title: STOLEN VEHICLE RECOVERED
item.description: 915PM-LIBERTY COUNTY SHERIFF’S OFFICE HAS JUST LOCATED A STOLEN VEHICLE FROM MONTGOMERY COUNTY THAT HAS BEEN BURNED ON COUNTY ROAD 3709. NO DESCRIPTION ON VEHICLE YET
